slides.headline: Who actually owns your *domain*?
slides.sub: Two myths about .uk domains. Tap through.

slides.title: Paid for it, so it's yours?
instead: I paid for it, so it's mine.
try: It belongs to whoever's named as the *registrant*.
If your web designer put it in their name, it's theirs on paper.

slides.title: You'll get a reminder?
instead: If it's about to lapse, I'll hear about it.
try: Nominet's reminders go to the *registrant's* email.
Miss them and a .uk domain stops working at day 30, website and email. From day 90 anyone can register it.

slides.title: Check yours in *two minutes*
steps: Log in where your domain's registered
Not your designer, not an old employee
Is the email one you actually read?
